items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I had an incident with Chris Kenner there... Chris Kenner wanted to punch me in the mouth.

ctx.x: How do you mean it had gone down?

Well, you know, attendance was why people had started going to other places. Because, you know, bad bands always run people. And so after I started playing there, the place came back up. And I stayed there so long. But I said that's why I got to know Frank Fairley well, you know, know where he was coming from. Oh, Chris Kenner. I had an incident with Chris Kenner there. And when Chris Kenner had Sick and Tired, and I had rehearsed Sick and Tired for me, Chris Kenner did it in B-flat and I was doing it in Key of…

You don't get me on all that bad. You don't get me on all that bad. You don't get me on all that bad. Embarrass me. Oh, she cursed words and I didn't say nothing to him. You know, cause the only thing I said, well, he didn't know what key he was singing in. I played it. We played in different keys.
